answerChoices.label: A
answerChoices.text: is a hyperbola intersecting only the \(x\)-axis

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text: is a hyperbola intersecting only the \(y\)-axis

answerChoices.label: C
answerChoices.text: is a hyperbola intersecting neither axis

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text: is a pair of straight lines

solutions.text:
Factoring, \[ x^2-4y^2=(x-2y)(x+2y). \] Thus the graph is the union of the two straight lines \(x=2y\) and \(x=-2y.\)

The correct answer is D.
hints: A product is zero when at least one of its two linear factors is zero
